prompt_text: Who is the best roofer in Denver for hail damage repair?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” roofer for every Denver home, but **Gates Enterprises** looks like a strong first call for hail damage: its Denver service page reports a **4.9-star rating across 348+ Google reviews**, and it handles storm inspections, damage documentation, repairs, and insurance-related work. [Gates Enterprises](https://www.gatesroof.com/areas/denver)

I’d also get a comparison quote from **Cenco Roofing**, which reports 4.9/5 from 843 reviews and specializes in hail damage, or **Hilltop Contracting**, which lists BBB A+ accreditation and TAMKO Pro certification. Those ratings and credentials are company-reported or directory-listed, so verify them independently before hiring.

Get at least two written estimates, confirm the contractor’s current Colorado/local licensing and insurance, and don’t sign over insurance benefits or feel pressured to sign at the door.
